title: OSD fingerprint 0.2
description: What a detection observed of one device plugged in, and the device the person confirmed it is. Matched against device descriptors (their identity block and controls) to recognise a model that does not identify itself; confirmed fingerprints teach the next detection. It holds nothing about the person or the machine: port names are kept as their words, without numbers.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

via.description: A web browser (no USB identity) or a program on the machine.

ports.description: The device's MIDI port names, lower case, words only.
